pl-l4d24c9-d1e115.summary: States that the fifth is the order of subdeacons.

pl-l4d24c9-d1e118.summary: Explains that the Greek 'hypodiacones' are our subdeacons, named because they are subject to the commands and offices of the Levites: they receive the faithful's offerings in the temple and bring them to the Levites for the altars; among the Hebrews they are called Nathinaei, serving the Lord in humility.

pl-l4d24c9-d1e130.summary: States that the subdeacon brings the chalice and paten to Christ's altar and hands them to the Levites, serves them, holds the cruet, basin, and towel, and gives water to the bishop, priests, and Levites for washing hands before the altar.
claims: Subdeacons bring the sacred vessels and assist at the altar.

pl-l4d24c9-d1e137.summary: States that the law of continence is imposed on them, since, approaching the altar, they carry the vessels of Christ's body and blood, and must fulfil 'be clean, you who carry the vessels of the Lord'.

pl-l4d24c9-d1e143.summary: Adds that they place on the altar as much of the offerings as suffices for the people, and wash the corporals, palls, and altar cloths.
claims: Subdeacons prepare offerings and wash altar linens.

pl-l4d24c9-d1e149.summary: States that at ordination they receive from the bishop an empty paten and chalice, and from the archdeacon the cruet, basin, and towel.
claims: Subdeacons receive the vessels at ordination.

pl-l4d24c9-d1e155.summary: States that the Lord used this office when he girded himself with a towel, poured water into a basin, and washed and dried the disciples' feet.

pl-l4d24c9.summary: Fifth is the order of subdeacons, called so because they are subject to the Levites' commands, receiving offerings and bringing them to the Levites; among the Hebrews called Nathinaei, serving the Lord in humility. They bring the chalice and paten to the altar, hold the cruet and towel, offer water for washing hands; the law of continence is imposed on them since they carry the vessels of Christ's body and blood; they place enough offerings on the altar and wash the altar linens. At ordination they receive an empty paten and chalice from the bishop and the cruet and towel from the archdeacon. Christ used this office in washing the disciples' feet.
claims: Subdeacons serve the deacons at the altar.
They receive paten, chalice, and cruet at ordination.
Christ exercised this office in washing feet.
